We're Fairphone, from Amsterdam. For everyone that wants tech to fuel life, not interrupt it.
We’re all about giving you quality tech that’s built to last and made better.

Our Journey so Far

For over a decade, we’ve done what others said couldn’t be done. Modular phones. Built to last. Made fair from the inside out.
Longer lifecycles, smarter upgrades, and real progress with every new generation. What sets Fairphone apart? It’s not just our values. It’s how those values show up — in the product itself.

Designed with Care

At Fairphone, innovation doesn't mean adding more — it means adding intention. It means asking: what do people really need? And how do we design for that — while still thinking about the makers of our devices and the planet itself?

Innovation doesn’t start on the surface. It starts at the source — in how a phone is made, who it empowers, and how long it lasts. We call it impact innovation. Great performance. Real values.

Make an

Impact

Pushing boundaries isn’t a feature — it’s our foundation.

It’s more important than ever for companies to take responsibility. To lead by example. To show what’s possible when you build not just for the next product cycle — but for the next generation. And that’s exactly what Fairphone is all about.

Net Zero by 2045

The biggest commitment we can all make is to hold onto our phones for longer. If we did that, we’d reduce carbon emissions created through new phone production, transport, waste, and usage. That’s why our devices are built to last. Beyond that, as a company, we realize we can do more. And for us, that means going to net zero.

SEE OUR IMPACT REPORT

Meet the Makers

Better pay. Safer factories. Less harm to people and planet. We work directly with our suppliers to improve wages and build safer, fairer workplaces. Together, we co-create real plans — and invest in making them happen.

Since 2019, we’ve invested over $1 million in living wage bonuses for the people who make our products. It’s one step toward a more equal supply chain — and we’re just getting started.

Frequently asked questions

How long do I have to return my order?

You have 14 days from the date of delivery to register your return request online.

Can I return a product I bought from another store (e.g., Amazon, MediaMarkt)?

No. The online return form is exclusive to items purchased directly from the Fairphone webshop. If you purchased your device from a partner or third-party retailer, please contact them directly to handle your return.

What condition should the item be in?

To be eligible for a refund, items must be in new, unused condition with original packaging and all tags attached.

Are there any items I cannot return?

Yes. Certain items are ineligible for return, such as Final Sale items.

Is return shipping free?

Return shipping is free. However, if user damage is found, then a fee will be levied to return the device.

Will I be refunded for the original shipping cost?

All full returns will receive refunds for shipping costs. Partial returns will not.

How long will it take to get my refund?

Once we receive your package and our warehouse validates the return, please allow up to five business days for the refund to appear on your original payment method.

What information do I need to start my return?

You will need your order number and the email address used to place the order.

My device is damaged or not working. Should I return it here?

We recommend using our repairs and troubleshooting page to find a solution first, before attempting to return your device. Our customer support agents will help you figure out whether a return is needed or not.

How do I send the package back?

Once you register your return online, you will be able to print a shipping label instantly. Simply attach it to the box and drop it off at a UPS access point.

What we believe in

Software longevity

We started Fairphone with a mission: to encourage smartphone longevity by disrupting the electronics industry from the inside. We know that fairness is possible, but it will take the broader industry jumping on the bandwagon, taking responsibility and driving as well as demanding change. We often say that software is the unsung hero of longer-lasting phones. So in 2022 we upgraded the Fairphone 2 to Android 10 – that’s 7 years of software support. Without the help of the Open-Source community, this industry-first would never have been possible. This is why we need and will always continue to support Open-Source ambitions.

Control your data

Chances are you’ve grown increasingly aware of data security over the past few years; this isn’t just about protecting your email password or credit card number anymore. We’ve seen first hand, in real-time, the cost of intensive data extraction on our society. There are huge forces at play here, but we hope to influence them by increasing awareness and availability of open-source software

(like /e/OS)

. We’re making a statement by offering The Fairphone (Gen. 6) and Fairphone 5 with /e/OS pre-installed on our webshop.

7 years of software support

In 2022, our 7-year-old Fairphone 2 was upgraded to Android 10 – that’s 7 years of software support. An industry first for an Android device!

We’re on a journey to change the electronics industry, and our superpower is our incredible community! We collaborated with the Fairphone open source community to help build the operating system. At Fairphone, we’re constantly raising the bar for ourselves and the industry, proving that it is possible to put sustainability at the heart of technology.

Your hardware is only as good as your software. If

Here’s resident software engineer, Karsten Tausche, explaining how we kept the Fairphone 2 going so long, software-wise.

How do we ensure updates happen?

Source builds from AOSP

We rely on the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) for the latest OS builds. This comes not only from Google, but also from other hardware suppliers, companies and communities, as it’s an open source project. So everyone can also get involved!

Adapt software for Fairphone

We mostly do this alone, in conjunction with our partners and customers, but we’re also very active in lobbying for how other hardware suppliers can support us more. This also happens on an annual basis with every upgrade we do.

Approvals and quality controls

Our tailored software undergoes extensive testing. We need to comply with several different quality checks for our software to pass.

Repeat software adaptation and approvals for each update

1. Google approval

Compliance tests ensure that the Android ecosystem is consistent, and apps work as they should.

2. Internal quality approval

We test internally, with our own development partners, with users and our community.

3. Partner and network approval

We ensure the phone works well for calling and network features.

Our best real-world example.

The Fairphone 2’s complete product cycle perfectly illustrates our approach.

7 years

In 2022, the Fairphone 2 received an update to Android 10. At the time, it was unheard of for an Android manufacturer to still be

5 years above average

It was a lofty goal. In 2022, the Fairphone 2 was the only phone with a Qualcomm Snapdragon 801 chipset that was still receiving active software support. Every other contemporary device with a similar chipset had reached their end-of-life five whole years ago.

480.000 tests

Why is Fairphone taking part in a Black Friday promotion? Is it not against your philosophy and a symbol of mass consumption? Has Fairphone changed its values by joining Black Friday?

Not at all. Our mission continues to be to build sustainable tech products that last. At Fairphone, we have always been (and still are) against wasteful overconsumption. We truly believe that repair is always better than replace, and design our products to be modular and long-lasting for precisely that reason. Longer lasting products equals less e-waste.

At the same time, it makes perfect sense that people want to be budget-conscious and save a bit of money if they can, especially when making big-ticket purchases. And Black Friday has become that moment for a lot of people, regardless of whether we participate. We have always approached the electronics industry and the change we want to bring from a realistic point of view. Engaging over boycotting, diving in over playing it safe. So, instead of ignoring Black Friday, we want to use this opportunity to encourage people to choose fair and shop responsibly, by investing in devices that last longer and are easier to repair.

We don’t want existing Fairphone owners to upgrade their devices unnecessarily. We would much rather they invest in device longevity. At the same time, we do want to reach people outside our fold, who are already in the market for a new device, and encourage them to make the fairer, more sustainable choice. Our offers are designed accordingly as well. We have protective bundles for new Fairphone owners to help extend their device’s lifespan even more. We’re also offering discounts on accessories and spare parts, encouraging existing Fairphone owners to keep their current products for longer.

Why are you running more than one Black Friday promotion?

Our approach to discounts and offers is geared towards promoting the wider adoption of long-lasting tech, and maximizing device longevity as much as possible. We want to encourage more people to choose fair, long-lasting tech, that will help them say no to Black Friday for the next five to eight years. We also want to encourage existing Fairphone owners to keep their devices for longer, choosing repair over replace. Hence, we have a few select offers to cater to every kind of customer.

What is a protective bundle?

As the name suggests, the Protective Bundle is designed to keep your Fairphone device even more protected, helping it to last even longer. The bundle includes a free screen protector and protective case, with the variant and color of your choice.

Is this greenwashing?

We are not promoting unnecessary upgrades. We are encouraging people to buy only what they need, and to choose repair over replace whenever they can. Very far away from consuming for the sake of it.

Why participate now?

By participating responsibly, we can guide purchases toward long-lasting, sustainable and fairer electronics, which is better for the people who make our devices and the planet at large. We’re also inviting wider audiences to join the Fairphone mission and increase the circle of impact and influence.

Will Fairphone do Black Friday every year?

We’re taking it one year at a time. If our Black Friday offers encourage more people to choose fair, then that is a very positive sign for us. At the same, we’re hoping to see more current Fairphone owners take advantage of our repair-oriented offers instead of replacing their devices with a newer model.

What about rising e-waste and climate impact? Aren't you bothered by those?

Our devices are designed to reduce waste through longevity, repairability, and recycling programs, alongside being 100% e-waste neutral. Encouraging people to choose fair this time will help them comfortably skip Black Friday for the next eight years.

How does this align with Fairphone’s sustainability mission?

We are still very much fighting for fairness in supply chains and promoting longevity in design. However, a crucial part of our mission is to also show the industry that there is a market for what we’re doing. We want to show that if people are offered a sustainable alternative for their tech needs, they will choose fair. Add extra storage with an microSD card

With Fairphone, you can always upgrade your onboard storage by adding an external microSD card. This can scale up your device space up to a whopping 2TB, which is more than enough for all your photos, videos, and other data. When it comes to choosing the right card for your device, we recommend picking one with a fast read/write speed.

Back up your data automatically

Take advantage of your Google account and back up your photos and videos automatically to the cloud through the Google One service. All you have to do is switch on automatic back-ups within Google Photos and all your precious memories will be accessible to you across devices. If you’re logged into your Google account on your Android device, it will also automatically back up your apps, contacts, and other system settings from time to time, making data migration that much more convenient.

Customize your home screen and more

If you want to customize your home and lock screens, press and hold on an empty space. This will bring up a pop-up menu which you can to use to add widgets, change the wallpaper, and tweak home settings. Changing the wallpaper will also adjust the color palette of your device to match it. You can also customize the exact colors if you’d like, as well as the fonts, font sizes, and grid layouts. There are even more options available in your settings. For example, try toggling Dark Mode, which will flip your colors to darker backgrounds and hues. Some people find this easier on the eyes.

Keep tabs on your phone usage

If you’re concerned that you’re spending too much time on your phone, you’ll love the Digital Wellbeing corner in your Fairphone. Parked in your settings, it gives you a clear overview of your phone behavior on a daily and weekly basis. You get to see all sorts of data from how much time your display has been on, to what apps you have been using the most, to how many times you’ve unlocked your device. Here, you can also set app timers if you’d like, switch on bedtime mode, or experiment with focus modes.

With The Fairphone (Gen. 6), we have taken it one step further with Fairphone Moments. Flip of the lime switch on the side and turn on a brand new minimalist mode that allows you to truly be in the moment and focus on what matters. No pings. No noise.

Extend battery life with charging modes

How your phone charges can also help to extend the battery’s life in the long run. Your Fairphone comes with two charging modes that you can choose between depending on the situation. Eco Mode is what we recommend for regular day-to-day charging; this ensures your battery is getting it power at optimum speeds and levels. But if you’re in a time-crunch, switch on Fast Charging Mode and your battery will push it to the max, charging up much faster than normal.

Make your device easier to use

Thanks to improved accessibility settings, Fairphones are usable for all with varying accessibility needs. To name just a few examples, you’ll find in the Settings app options for screen readers, voice controls, font sizes, color correction, touch controls, captions, and hearing aid preferences. All of which you can set up and easily access with shortcuts.

How long will The Fairphone (Gen. 6) be supported for?

We will be supporting the new Fairphone till 2033 at least, with regular security patches, software updates, and spare parts availability. You will also receive at least seven Android OS upgrades during that time.

How is the Fairphone (Gen. 6)’s performance compared to the Fairphone 5?

The new Fairphone comes with a powerful Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 processor that promises faster performance that is energy efficient. Software support is guaranteed until 2033, and at least seven Android upgrades. The removable 4415mAh battery lasts up to two days on a single charge as well.

Is The Fairphone (Gen 6) truly the most sustainable and ethical smartphone from Fairphone?

Yes. The new Fairphone contains more than 50% fair and recycled materials (by total weight), while supporting living wage bonuses and worker voice programs. It is climate-conscious and 100% e-waste neutral, and, as per the data available to us, will have the lowest carbon footprint of all our smartphones yet. To learn more about our impact work,

read our latest Impact Report here
.

What are the plans for the support of alternative OSes?

The Fairphone (Gen. 6) is

available for sale with Murena’s deGoogled /e/OS pre-installed

Please note that, in order to receive warranty support from Fairphone, it is necessary to switch your phone back to the stock Android operating system.

Our five-year warranty is the longest warranty offered by any smartphone manufacturer currently. It consists of a standard two-year warranty, plus a free three-year extended warranty.

Learn more about it on our Warranty page
.

Frequently asked questions

What is /e/OS and how is it different from the Fairphone (Gen. 6) (Android)?

The Fairphone (Gen. 6) is available with two operating system confirmations on our web shop. While the hardware is identical, the software experience is different.

The Fairphone (Gen. 6)

The standard version provides the conventional Android experience with Google Mobile Services pre-installed.

The Fairphone (Gen. 6) with /e/OS

This version provides a privacy-focused experience with /e/OS. This is an open-source operating system that does not include Google apps or services, a design intended to reduce data tracking. The /e/OS version comes with its own set of default applications for core functions and uses the App Lounge to provide access to a wide range of Android applications.

Can I change the operating system from /e/OS to Android after purchase if I decide it’s not for me?

Yes, the initial choice of operating system is not permanent. It is possible to switch between the standard Android OS and /e/OS after purchasing the device.

This process will require unlocking your bootloader along with other steps.

Here is our guide

on reinstalling Android to you Fairphone

Can I still use my banking app and other essential Android apps on the /e/OS version?

Yes, the /e/OS version provides access to a wide range of Android applications through the App Lounge. This includes many common banking, social media, and messaging services. The App Lounge also displays a privacy rating for each application, detailing its data trackers and required permissions to help you make an informed choice.

While most applications are available and function as expected, those that depend heavily on Google Mobile Services (Drive, Gmail etc) for their core features may have limited functionality or be unavailable.

Check /e/OS’s community forum

to search for specific app compatibility.

Does using /e/OS (or another OS) affect support and warranty?

Yes, the support process is different depending on the operating system you use. While you can switch between the standard Android OS and /e/OS at any time

using Fairphone's ‘Easy Installer’ tool

, it's important to understand the support structure.

/e/OS support

/e/OS is a separate operating system developed and maintained by our partner, Murena. Because Fairphone's diagnostic tools and support services are built for the standard Android OS, the device must be ideally running this software for our team to provide effective hardware and software support.

For any warranty claim to be processed by Fairphone, the device must first be restored to the standard Android OS. Exceptions to this rule are only for devices that were bought with /e/OS pre-installed by Fairphone or Murena, in which case you do not have to install Android.

Custom ROMs

This policy also applies to all other alternative operating systems (custom ROMs). While using a different OS does not void your warranty for unrelated hardware failures, damage caused by the software itself is not covered. Warranty does not cover issues caused during installation of an alternative OS.

For more information, read our support article

about warranty with an alternative OS.
